dogecoin.text: @gladstein @TheStalwart @JacobKing81 But Dogecoin does not offer any different nor better utility than Bitcoin.  IMO, that is the core reason it will eventually wane.

@TheStalwart @gladstein @JacobKing81 Ok, but nothing prevents other users to fork and remain in the older version.

In my view the main reason is that Dogecoin does not provide any functionality that Bitcoin doesn't have to offset what you lose by dilution of your share (inflation)
